program4='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            todo=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); cells=set()
            while todo:
                y,x=todo.pop();cells.add((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
                        seen.add((yy,xx));todo.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((col,cells))
    # Recolor a short component to the color of the nearby isolated marker.
    singletons=[(col,next(iter(cells))) for col,cells in comps if len(cells)==1]
    triples=[(col,cells) for col,cells in comps if len(cells)==3]
    if triples and singletons:
        col,cells=min(triples,key=lambda x:min(abs(r-sr)+abs(c-sc) for r,c in x[1] for _,(sr,sc) in singletons))
        marker=min(singletons,key=lambda x:min(abs(r-x[1][0])+abs(c-x[1][1]) for r,c in cells))
        out=[row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=marker[0]
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
